notes.title: Update #15 available for download!
notes.content:
Good news! We just released our latest major updates for Bus Simulator 18. The update introduces new trophies for owners of the official map extension DLC, solves some issues regarding the trophies of the main game and includes a number of bugfixes as well as numerous performance and overall game improvements. Here is a detailed overview of the changes:
[b]Patch notes: Update #15[/b]
[list]
[*]Official Map Extension DLC achievements added.
[*]Fixed that some base game achievements required the player to own the Official Map Extension
[*]Made collectibles always spawn, even if the player has already found them.
[*]Found and rescued the married couple trophy
[*]Fixes and performance improvements to NPC buses (also improves performance during national holidays)
[*]Improve multiplayer initial synchronization bandwidth usage
[*]The cashier setting for co-op missions is now working again
[*]Fixed several bus and route unlocking issues in multiplayer
[*]Several fixes for the bus customization menu
[*]Fix that some settings were not saved.
[*]Improved looks and LODs of the NPC Cars
[*]Several UI focus improvements and fixes
[*]Voicechat now instantly gets applied after changing the checkbox value
[*]Fixed Wheelchair passenger AI so they always only take the door with the Ramp
[*]Fixed some bus selection issues, most important that the rental bus was not automatically selected
[*]Improved input device switching
[*]Fix custom license plates for bus models that had issues with them
[*]Fixed Iveco Driver Door Material for the bottom left corner (Was Floor texture)
[*]Normal buses no longer count towards bendy bus objective in the Student Exchange mission
[*]Fixed airport stop direction being reversible causing the route to become invalid
[*]Several smaller bugfixes and game improvements
[/list]

PS: The next bus pack DLCs are currently in preparation. We hope you are looking forward to them as much as we do. :-)

Your Bus Simulator team

notes.title: Update #14 available now!
notes.content:

[*]Smaller fixes in the DLC shop system of the Bus Shop
[*]A community-provided Italian localization has been added.
[*]Some optimizations on initial synchronization bandwidth usage in multiplayer
[*]UI Mirrors are no longer disappearing randomly when opening the pause menu
[*]Changes in the game’s Controls settings menu will be saved again
[*]A number of smaller bug fixes and game improvements 
[/list]

Your Bus Simulator team

notes.title: Update #13 incl. our new zoom function for the Minimap available now!
notes.content:
Good news: We just released our latest update for Bus Simulator 18 In addition to a number of smaller game improvements the update also introduces a frequently requested new feature – a zoom function for the Minimap. Here is a short overview of the most important improvements:

[b]Patch notes - Update #13:[/b]

[b]New Feature:[/b]
Zoom function of the Minimap
[list]

Our latest update for Bus Simulator 18 has been release here on Steam today. Next to further game and performance improvements the update also includes some new features: Full-Controller support, Triple Monitor support, Online-Radio and our new Ingame-News feature. [b]Performance:[/b]
We upgraded the performance of Bus Simulator 18. Especially for the owners of the Map Extension the performance update is noticeable.

[b]Triple Monitor Support[/b]
(Settings > Graphic > Triple Monitor Support)
We are introducing a new option to experience Bus Simulator 18. Triple Monitor is now supported. You are now able to change into Triple Monitor Mode and enjoy the additional field of view. You will find the option to change into the Triple Monitor Mode in the graphic settings.

(Settings > Audio > Online Radio)
To enjoy your favorite online streams, we implemented an online radio feature. You just need to copy an URL of your favorite radio stream and insert it into the settings menu. You can insert more streams into the settings menu and if you are bored of one stream you can just push the next button and another stream will start.

Bus Simulator 18 now offers full controller support! Play with any Steam supported gamepad with the UI designed with controllers in mind.
Just plug-in your controller and press any button when the game is running to switch to controller mode. For some controller types "Configuration Support" needs to be enabled in the Steam "General Controller Settings”. (Steam>Settings>Controller>General Controller Setings)

notes.content:
Dear bus drivers,
We just released Update #8 for Bus Simulator 18. This update includes a number of new features which will offer the option to customize your driving experience as well as the bus physics according your needs. Next to this the update includes numerous bug fixes and game improvements. Here are the detailed patch notes:

[b]Patch notes – Update #8 (June 24, 2019)[/b]

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Drive settings[/b] [i](Menu: Start Drive > Open Advanced Settings)[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Speed bumps:[/b] The player can deactivate speed bumps entirely or set a custom threshold at which the player receives a penalty for driving too fast over the bump.
[*][b]Potholes:[/b] Similarly to speed bumps, the player can set a custom threshold at which potholes penalize the player or deactivate them entirely.
[*][b]Speed cameras:[/b] Speed cameras can be deactivated entirely or a custom "Speed camera tolerance" can be set.
[/list]

[*][b]Bus physics[/b] [i](Menu: Start Drive > Open Advanced Settings)[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Brake strength factor:[/b] This setting allows the player to adjust the braking strength of all buses. Higher values mean shorter braking distances while lower values lengthen the braking distance.
[*][b]Friction factor:[/b] The friction factor can now be adjusted freely - the higher the setting is adjusted, the more stable is the busses grip on the street. 
[*][b]Mass factor:[/b] Players can adjust the mass factor of the buses. Increasing the mass factor will make the bus accelerate more slowly and it will become harder to reach the possible top speed of the vehicle.
[*][b]Suspension factor:[/b] The suspension factor can be changed from 0.5 to 5. A lower value makes the suspension softer and creates a "smoother" driving experience. Choosing a higher value makes the suspension stiffer.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Bus Simulator 18: Update #4 available now!
notes.content:
Good news: We just released the 4th major update for Bus Simulator 18 today. The update focuses on a number of additional performance optimizations as well as some general game improvements and bug fixes. More detailed information can be found in our changelog:

[b]Changelog – Update #4[/b]

[b]Optimizations:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tweak level of detail and shadow settings on various assets throughout the level to improve performance.
[*]NPC car level of detail and rendering settings have been tweaked for higher performance.
[*]The calculation of the NPC car orientation and position on the road is now done in parallel for all cars.
[*]Some PhysX queries are now done in an asynchronous manner, so the game logic needn't wait for them to finish.
[*]The route finding of our NPC cars and NPC buses is now done in an asynchronous manner in order to reduce micro stutter.
[*]Ring menu description texts are now placed inside a floating label in order to improve readability.
[*]Some ring menu buttons were re-arranged to improve usability.
[*]The animations of the bus cockpit have been optimized to use less CPU time.
[*]A performance bug in the code that updates audio effects when the player boards or dismounts the bus has been fixed.
[*]The data needed by passengers to find their way through the bus is now stored in a more efficient way, that does no longer require CPU time whenever the bus moves.
[*]NPC cars do not longer own a radio if they do not intend to use it. (Internal optimization to save performance).
[*]If the lights of a NPC car are turned off, it doesn’t carry the bloom effects for it around anymore.
[*]Functions that get called every frame on passengers and pedestrians are now fully implemented in C++. Previously they still had small parts implemented in the slower Blueprint scripting language.
[*]NPC cars no longer have any Blueprint code. They were fully ported to C++ for performance reasons.
[*]The handling of inputs axes, head tracking and mouse steering has been ported from Blueprint to C++ to improve performance.
[*]Car and bus animations have been made thread-safe by enabling multithreaded animation updates for them.
[*]The calculation of force feedback strength has been optimized.
[*]Change how some data is transferred in multiplayer. This should make the connection more tolerant to lags.
[*]Oncoming traffic now reacts a bit smarter when the player uses the indicators.
[*]Improved driver character steering wheel grabbing and improved performance of this code.
[*]The minimap in the bus and in the user interface are now displaying the same image, instead of rendering nearly the same thing twice. (Optimization to save performance).
[*]An icon for stop requests has been added to the UI minimap. It replaces the redundant icon for bus kneeling.
[*]Some parts of the minimap UI have been ported from Blueprint to C++ to improve performance.
[*]Loading times for several of the sub-levels of the default map have been improved in order to reduce stutters during level streaming.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed that windscreen wipers sometimes drifted slowly away from the bus.
[*]Fixed that the camera could clip into cars.
[*]Fixed that passengers trying to find their way to enter the bus would sometimes walk right through the bus.
[*]Fixed weird looking passenger movement while boarding the rear part of the bendy bus if the bus was bent.
[*]Fixed that the tutorial would continue after the player sold the wrong ticket to the passenger.
[*]Improved driver model positioning in Citaro K.
[*]Fixed that passengers spawned, but not picked up during the tutorial were waiting forever for their bus.
[*]Fixed that passengers would walk quite a distance if there was something blocking all shorter ways to the bus.
[*]Fixed several smaller localization issues.
[*]Fixed several “crash on exit” issues.
[*]Fixed that one of the truck models in game had mirrored indicator lights when viewed from far away.
[*]Fixed a crash bug when accepting a Steam multiplayer invite from the BS18 main menu.
[*]Fixed a crash related to faulty savegame files.
[*]Fixed that a bus driving on rail tracks could get traffic priority over cars at the railway crossing.
[*]Fixed that the player sometimes was unable to exit the ticket machine UI using a controller.
[*]Fixed a crash bug in host transfer, that triggered sometimes if a player bus happened to be on a crossroads during the disconnect.
[*]It should now be possible to stop the bus at all stations, without it sliding slowly downhill.
[/list]

[b]Modding:[/b]
[list]
[*]A new wheel handler for buses and bendy bus rear parts has been added that yields better performance. In order to get it to work, the animation blueprint needs to have the correct base class. See the updated example buses for details.
[*]Passenger move trees and passenger move nodes are no longer needed at runtime. It's now possible to set all passenger move trees and passenger move nodes on the bus blueprint to "Editor Only Component".
[/list]

[i][b]Important note for mod creators:[/b] Please note that we uploaded a new version of our Bus Simulator 18: Modding Kit. The updated version enables you to use some of the new performance optimizations for your mods too. More detailed information can be found in our Modding Kit Documentation: https://docs.google.com/document/d/145HmPFdIWdLTnIr6GHrecBjGIC84jRUgQLQUMtY9J4Q/ [/i]

notes.title: Bus Simulator 18: Free Mission Pack #1 now available!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32551586/632fcb8e216c4c00546e7a7eb6eeadc3c6d72077.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32551586/6b91b9bad5c459592d98e06ccabd8394cce29c5e.jpg[/img][/url]

Dear bus drivers,

Free mission pack #1 for Bus Simulator 18 is now available to download here on Steam.

After focusing on general game improvements and content such as the license plate generator and the free country skin & decal pack DLC, stillalive studios and astragon entertainment have now come up with the next big surprise for the Bus Simulator 18 community: the first brand-new mission pack. It offers a whole set of new missions for advanced bus drivers! Just like in the previous missions, the new tasks have charming voice-overs by professional actors.

Mission Pack #1 expands Bus Simulator 18 by adding three brand-new missions, along with a number of challenging sub-tasks that focus on boosting tourism in the city of Seaside Valley. In addition to special points of interest and hiking tourism, the nightlife of Seaside Valley plays a crucial role, too. As a reward for completing the new tasks, players can look forward to three brand-new decals, a complete bus skin, and a range of new colors they can use to customize their bus fleet.

Enjoy!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32551586/632fcb8e216c4c00546e7a7eb6eeadc3c6d72077.jpg[/img]


[b]Patchnotes:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 new missions presented by Max Klein added.
[*] Camera lag is now also disabled in third person. This should fix some bus stuttering issues while the framerate is not stable.
[*] Parked car license plates set to not cast shadows, to be culled at 50 meters, and to not keep their instance buffer in the main memory.
[*] A construction site in the inner city was moved slightly so cars no longer clip through it.
[*] Streamlined loading screen visuals.
[*] License plates no longer glow in the dark.
[*] Mission info UI no longer automatically opens when the driver and bus assignment menu is open.
[*] Toggling between third and first person view now places the camera at a maximum distance instead of in the center of the range.
[*] Fixed issue of the player name hovering in maps showing the wrong name.
[*] Improved how NPC cars drive onto the highway.
[*] Customization items now show if they are unlocked by a mission or by a level up.
[*] Some very dark areas lit up.
[*] Loads of smaller bugfixes and general performance improvements.
[/list]

Dear bus drivers,

Our third update for Bus Simulator 18 is now available to download here on Steam. With update #3, you can now create your own license plate number and letter combination. Have fun!

notes.title: Bus Simulator 18: Update #2 available now!
notes.content:
Dear bus drivers,

Our second update for Bus Simulator 18 is now available for download here on Steam. The main focus is a number of performance and traffic AI improvements as well as numerous additional bug fixes. More detailed information can be found in the patch notes below:

[b]Patch Notes Update #2[/b]
[list]
[*]Numerous textures were optimized to reduce memory usage and loading times.
[*]Cashier buttons can now be controlled with steering wheel buttons, but you need to take care to avoid double assignment.
[*]Passenger pathfinding while boarding the bus has been improved.
[*]If even with the improved pathfinding passengers clip into the stopped bus, starting to drive no longer generates a penalty.
[*]If the player has Logitech drivers installed and they allow it in the settings, the pedal axis separation setting is automatically set to CombinePedals=false.
[*]Added input rebinding widgets for IncreaseRetarderStrength and DecreaseRetarderStrength in the normal controls and steering wheel section.
[*]Optimized pedestrian spawning/despawning logic to improve performance.
[*]Tweaked update rate of audio volumes to improve performance.
[*]Fixed issue that clients can no longer join a multiplayer company if too many buses have customization on them.
[*]A bug in the traffic AI has been fixed, which caused NPC cars that did not have priority over the player to sometimes cut in right in front of the player.
[*]NPC cars are now more reluctant to waive their priority to prevent situations where traffic no longer follows right-of-way rules because everyone is letting everyone else pass.
[*]The player positions are now shown on the minimap.
[*]Gamma settings are now remembered correctly.
[*]Drive statistics now list all players that participated in a co-op mission.
[*]When using Quick Start, the bus is placed much closer to the first bus stop if the stop is on a long road.
[*]Reduced lag spike that occurred when loading a sublevel that contains parked cars.
[*]Fixed lag spike caused by trains reaching the end of the tracks.
[*]NPC character movement has been optimized to reduce the performance impact of having lots of passengers in the bus.
[*]Movement of NPC cars has been optimized in a similar way to reduce their performance impact.
[*]The map has been optimized to reduce GPU load.
[/list]

[b]Important note:[/b] The game's Force Feedback setting offers a scale from 0 to 100 now. So select 100 to get full Force Feedback. (Settings > Game > Force Feedback)

notes.title: Bus Simulator 18: Update #1 Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear bus drivers,

Our first update for Bus Simulator 18 is now available for download here on Steam. Its focus lies on a number of performance-, controller- and steering wheel- improvements as well as numerous bug and localization fixes. More detailed information can be found in our patch notes below:

[b]Patchnotes June 25, 2018[/b]

[b]#techart[/b]
[*]Fixed numerous framerate drops, especially the one while the general hint widget is shown.
[*]Added a one-time-only popup at startup which tells you to activate PS4 controller support in Steam, if one is connected
[*]How much the in-game steering wheel rotates is now defined by the max angle on the BS18GameInstance (only if an actual steering wheel controller is connected)
[*]Added Logitech G920 steering wheel preset
[*]Added controller sensitivity settings
[*]Added SteeringWheel_LookLeftButton, SteeringWheel_LookRightButton, SteeringWheel_ResetCamPositionButton bindings
[*]Added steering wheel max range setting to the steering wheel settings
[*]Tobii, TrackIR and mouse steering settings are now only deactivated instead of hidden if they are not available
[*]Implemented new relative steering mode (and hooked up the respective settings)
[*]The cockpit zoom FOV is now always 50% of the cockpit FOV (so it also works better on triple monitor setup)
[*]Steering wheel buttons that are bound to virtual axle now work in-game (throttle / brake)
[*]Some steering settings are now disabled or enabled depending on the steering mode (relative / absolute)
[*]Increased possible FOV Range from 60-140 to 60-170
[*]Additional settings are now also reset once you reset the controls
[*]Allow achievements with installed mods, but not on installed mod maps
[*]Added button in the mod manager widget to disable unsubscribed mods
[*]Buses from deactivated mods will temporarily be replaced with a rental bus
[*]Bus stops are again shown on the UI minimap
[*]Updated FR, JA, KO and PT translation
[*]Added a minimum view pitch to the player controller to fix an issue with flipping camera orientations
[*]Fixed a wrong key check in rebind controls popup widget (Gamepad Trigger Left was checked twice instead of Left and Right)
[*]Fixed that rebinding a key/axis to the same key/axis could lead to nothing being bound even though it would show up in the UI
[*]Fixed that Tobii settings were always greyed out 
[*]Fixed that if a player would change steering wheel controls and then updates to a new version, which had new axles (lookleft/lookright/centercam) they would not be able to rebind those until they reset the controls once
[*]Fix loud music event log spam
[*]Changed ticket machine buttons collider extents to prevent accidentally pressing a neighbor button and enabled the hint overlays for the buttons (but not for ticket machine itself)
[*]Replaced intro video with quieter version
[*]Language setting is no longer deactivated while the game is playing as the user will be told to restart the game either way
[*]Updated localization and deactivated localization on certain objects
[*]Changed the way all bus doors are animated to store the target location on the bus-door-component instead (changed all buses to make it work again and tested all of them too)
[*]Fixed IVECO buses front door clipping into cockpit
[*]Minor fixes of some steering wheel presets.
[*]Second camera zoom axis is now correctly rebindable
[*]Updated localization
[/list]


[b]#code[/b]
[list]
[*]It should now be possible to load someone else's single player saves (will be renamed into a new GUID, and ownership will be taken over)
[*]Change how session searches are working. Searches are now enqueued and handled one after the other, first come, first serve.
[*]Fixed issue that mod ad revenue wasn't displayed correctly in customization menu
[*]Savegame update notifications are now only triggered once per frame per type of update, not for each unlocked or changed item immediately. This should fix the issue that on some missions not all unlocks get saved. 
[*]Separate XP addition and unlocks. Now XP based unlocks are applied retroactively, so if something should have been unlocked but wasn't, it's going to unlock after the next drive.
[*]Disable savegame upload to persistent server on clients
[*]Retroactively apply all unlocks for missions before the current one whenever a drive is finished.
[*]Filter persistent multiplayer savegame lobby searches in main menu by savegame BS18SessionName. Fixes issue that sometimes games were shown as not running, although they were.
[*]Update session information every 5 minutes, to have up-to-date UTC timestamps
[/list]


[b]#audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced volume of intro video
[*]Added three bus radio tracks
[/list]
